title: AS2: global variable declarations and _global scope
description: Implement _global scope in the AS2 compiler. In Flash 8, variables assigned to _global (e.g. _global.myVar = 5) are accessible from any scope. Also: class-level variable declarations (var x:Number = 5 at class body level) should compile to prototype assignments. Verify the compiler handles: (1) _global.foo = value → ActionPush 'foo', value; ActionPush '_global'; ActionGetVariable; ActionSetMember. (2) Top-level var declarations in scripts → ActionDefineLocal2 or ActionSetVariable. Add 6 tests in __tests__/globalvars.test.ts.
